content:
This commit 03616a12 to mathlib changes the URLs that lake exe cache get uses to fetch artifacts for the cache to a new endpoint, https://cache.mathlib.org/.

This new endpoint has been exercised in the mathlib CI for the past couple of weeks, and we expect a smooth transition, but please report any suspicious behavior here so we can investigate. We'll be monitoring our telemetry for any anomalies as well.

When reporting an issue, please keep in mind:

  • The changes are in effect if you are consuming a version of mathlib that includes the 03616a12 commit.
  • Related issues should manifest as new connection or transfer issues during lake exe cache get
  • Please include as much information as you can, including rough timestamps for the failure and your repository/fork information.

A MATHLIB_CACHE_DEBUG_USE_LEGACY environment variable can be set to 1 to fall back to the behavior before this change. Please note this variable is intended as a troubleshooting fallback and it might be retired at any time.

Thanks!
